name: bybit-testnet
purpose: A Bybit testnet account (test funds): market data, balances, orders, positions

apiKey.name: X-BAPI-API-KEY
apiKey.help: testnet.bybit.com → API → Create New Key (System-generated, HMAC); paste the API key and the secret

guide:
Bybit V5 REST API at https://api-testnet.bybit.com/v5, on the person's testnet account (test funds): bnbloc adds the person's key and signs account and trading requests. Send requests with no key, signature or timestamp.

```sh
# Market data
curl -s 'https://api-testnet.bybit.com/v5/market/tickers?category=spot&symbol=BTCUSDT'
# Balances
curl -s 'https://api-testnet.bybit.com/v5/account/wallet-balance?accountType=UNIFIED'
# Open orders
curl -s 'https://api-testnet.bybit.com/v5/order/realtime?category=spot'
# A limit order, then its cancellation
curl -s -X POST 'https://api-testnet.bybit.com/v5/order/create' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"category":"spot","symbol":"BTCUSDT","side":"Buy","orderType":"Limit","qty":"0.001","price":"20000"}'
curl -s -X POST 'https://api-testnet.bybit.com/v5/order/cancel' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"category":"spot","symbol":"BTCUSDT","orderId":"ORDER_ID"}'
```

Answers are `{"retCode":0,"retMsg":"OK","result":{…}}`; a `retCode` other than 0 is an error. Placing or cancelling an order asks the person first unless they allowed changes.
